summary: Preserve WHATWG URL scheme, credentials, host, hostname, and port getter/setter behavior.

semantics.setters: run component-specific basic URL parser states
semantics.default_port: serialized port becomes empty for the scheme default
semantics.host: includes non-empty port while hostname excludes it

caveats: Setter failure behavior differs by component; some invalid setter inputs are ignored instead of throwing.

tests.name: default port disappears
tests.expected_behavior: prints example.com example.com and an empty port

tests.name: username is encoded
tests.input: const u=new URL("https://example.com/"); u.username="a b"; console.log(u.href);
